name: Alameda County Social Services Agency VITA
description: Free tax preparation; help with EITC and CalEITC credits
fullDescription: Alameda County Social Services Agency offers free tax preparation through the IRS Volunteer Income Tax Assistance (VITA) program for low to moderate income residents.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free tax preparation for low- and moderate-income residents
- Help claiming Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC)
- CalEITC (California Earned Income Tax Credit) assistance
- IRS-certified volunteer preparers
- Document drop-off/pick-up or in-person appointments
- E-filing with direct deposit (refund in as little as 7-10 business days)
howToGetIt:
1. Check the Alameda County Social Services website for VITA site locations and hours (North Oakland, Hayward, and East Oakland sites)
2. Book an appointment through the ACSSA VITA/EITC Appointment Portal (available January-April)
3. Gather physical copies of required documents (photo ID, Social Security cards or ITIN letters, W-2s, 1099s)
4. Attend your scheduled appointment
5. Review and sign your return
keywords: VITA, Alameda County, free tax preparation, EITC, CalEITC, Earned Income Tax Credit, IRS certified, low income tax help, volunteer tax
